keeper_veyron.name: Keeper Veyron
keeper_veyron.description: A serene, enigmatic figure clad in patchwork robes, their face partially obscured by a silver mask. Keeper Veyron is known for their cryptic wisdom and ability to guide seekers through the paradoxes of the crossroads. They offer riddles and insight—sometimes both at once.

the_paradoxical_twins.name: The Paradoxical Twins
the_paradoxical_twins.description: A pair of identical merchants who always finish each other’s sentences, known for selling items that seem impossible or contradictory. They delight in bargains that challenge logic.

seraphine_of_the_silver_veil.name: Seraphine of the Silver Veil
seraphine_of_the_silver_veil.description: A poised, enigmatic woman wearing a shimmering mask of silver thread that conceals all but her luminous eyes and measured smile. She acts as both hostess and gatekeeper for all who enter the Veiled Districts, determining who may pass deeper. Her knowledge of secrets is legendary, and she trades in favors and whispered truths.
aliases: Seraphine of the Silver Veil (faction leader)

old_grem_the_cartographer.name: Old Grem the Cartographer
old_grem_the_cartographer.description: A wizened human hunched over a battered map case, Grem claims to have mapped every shifting street of the Crossroads—though no two maps are ever quite the same. He trades information and cryptic directions, sometimes for a drink, sometimes for a secret.

azarel_moros.name: Azarel Moros
azarel_moros.description: A gaunt, silver-haired mage in tattered blue robes, Azarel's eyes shimmer with fragments of shattered illusions. He seems both present and slightly out of phase with reality, as if the magic of the wards has begun to unravel his very form. Azarel is obsessed with repairing the city's magical fabric, but his mind teeters on the brink from constant exposure to the wards' chaos.

xhalruun_the_unraveled.name: Xhalruun the Unraveled
xhalruun_the_unraveled.description: An undead mind flayer whose psychic essence has fractured across dimensions. Xhalruun presides over the Sanctuary, preaching to invisible congregations and warping the boundaries of faith and reason. His true motives are enigmatic, but he is fixated on the party and the secret of Numillian's reality.
aliases: Xhalruun the Unraveled (antagonist, appearing in visions)

mira_the_shardseer.name: Mira the Shardseer
mira_the_shardseer.description: A spectral oracle bound by fractured fate, Mira appears as a translucent woman with dozens of glass-like shards suspended around her. She can see glimpses of possible futures but is fractured by the district's energies. Mira offers cryptic advice, often speaking in riddles, but she is fiercely protective of those who treat her kindly.

raxil_the_doubter.name: Raxil the Doubter
raxil_the_doubter.description: A gaunt, haunted figure draped in faded scholar’s robes, Raxil clutches a bundle of broken memory crystals. Raxil obsessively questions the veracity of everything, including the party’s very existence. He serves as the memory-keeper of the Unraveling Wards, tormented by the knowledge that most recollections here are unreliable.

malk_the_whisper.name: Malk the Whisper
malk_the_whisper.description: A stooped, thin figure garbed in patchwork robes, their face obscured by a cracked porcelain mask. Malk trades in secrets, listening to the hall’s whispers and sharing only what serves their mysterious agenda.

captain_lyra_voss.name: Captain Lyra Voss
captain_lyra_voss.description: A pragmatic, sharp-minded leader of an outcast faction, Lyra Voss seeks to restore stability to the Confluence. She offers the party alliance and information in exchange for tangible aid against Xhalruun or the growing madness.

glim.name: Glim
glim.description: A diminutive, bright-eyed goblin with a knack for acquiring curiosities that vanish as soon as they’re bought. Glim is well-connected and hears all the gossip of the crossroads.

various_masked_dignitaries.name: Various masked dignitaries
various_masked_dignitaries.description: A small gathering of influential figures in elaborate, distinctive masks, each hiding their true identity and allegiances. They are here to witness or enforce the outcomes of major bargains, and may offer the party new alliances—or threats—depending on what is revealed.

any_surviving_faction_leaders.name: Any surviving faction leaders
any_surviving_faction_leaders.description: Representatives of various groups who have barricaded themselves in the reliquary, desperately clinging to relics and half-truths in the hope of restoring stability to the Confluence.

fragmented_preceptor.name: Fragmented Preceptor
fragmented_preceptor.description: A once-whole priest now split into three illusory selves—each reflecting different truths or lies. The Preceptor can offer guidance, riddles, or dangerous half-truths about the Warrens and Numillian’s secrets. Sometimes helpful, sometimes a hindrance.

masquerade_steward.name: Masquerade Steward
masquerade_steward.description: A tall figure in an intricate mirrored mask, greeting arrivals with a smile that never quite reaches their eyes. The steward offers cryptic advice, subtly probing the party's intentions and mental fortitude.

masked_duelist.name: Masked Duelist
masked_duelist.description: A flamboyant swordsman in a shifting, glass-like mask, eager to test the wit and will of outsiders through psychic contests or riddles.

mind_flayer_archivist.name: Mind Flayer Archivist
mind_flayer_archivist.description: A gaunt, tentacled figure in tattered ceremonial finery, cataloging and curating psychic treasures. The archivist is aware of the party’s approach, both physically and mentally.
